label: Feed Entry
description: An entry from an Atom or RSS 2.0 feed, as the RSS connector reads it: a bookmark whose title and description are plain text and whose body keeps the feed's markup, with the entry's id in its feed and the feed's origin and address hash beside the bookmark's fields.

entry_id.description: The entry's id in its feed: its Atom id or RSS guid, else its link.

feed_origin.description: The origin of the feed's address: its scheme, host and port, without the path or query where a private feed carries its token.

feed_hash.description: A hash of the feed's address, the same for every entry of one feed, which names the feed where its address may not go.
